conditions.displayName: Uptime check on basecamper.ai/api/health failing from multiple regions

documentation.content: `GET /api/health` (liveness: DB + Redis reachability) is failing from more than one probe region. This is a user-facing outage until proven otherwise. Check Cloud Run service status and recent deploys first — `make rollback` restores the previous revision in seconds — then Cloud SQL and the Redis instance. The uptime check itself is provisioned by `make alerts-setup`.
